messages:
Sam (Acct Exec): Equinox legal asked for a concrete capacity & pricing proposal: reserved GPU counts, autoscale rules, preheat plan, and a committed monthly number. Need a customer-ready one-pager by Tue EOD.
Noor (Solutions Eng): On it. Quick clarifiers: p99 target? Peak window duration? Any DR constraints?
Sam (Acct Exec): p99 <300ms for short chat, steady 300-400 qps, short promo spikes to ~1.2k qps for ~10 minutes, nightly embedding batch ~2k req/min. Cross-AZ redundancy required; prefer Dedicated us-east primary, hosted fallback.
Noor (Solutions Eng): I ran a focused perf run on their sample payloads (job eqx-3401). Summary: rdx-embed-1.0-q4 -> ~3800 emb/s per GPU (batched), p95 ~90ms. rdx-chat-small-q4 -> ~700 short-chat qps per GPU, p95 ~220ms.
Javier (Infra): Suggested topology: mirrored reserved pools in 2 AZs. Reserve 3 GPUs per AZ (total 6). Min active 3 (one per AZ + spare), scale_reserved to 6, allow burst +2 GPUs (8 total) for promos. Sticky AZ routing; failover to sibling AZ then hosted.
billing-bot: price-estimate created id=pe-3401.
Noor (Solutions Eng): Preheat plan: cron warmup 15min before promos + nightly KV prime for top 10k prefixes. Example warmup curl one-liner provided in SOW. That reduces cold p95 by ~30-40% in tests.
Javier (Infra): Autoscale policy (draft): min_reserved_gpus=3; max_reserved_gpus=6; max_burst_gpus=8; scale_up when queue_depth>200 for 90s; scale_down_cooldown=300s. Eviction: overflow routes to hosted with throttling.
Sam (Acct Exec): Pricing note from buyer: wants a single committed monthly number if possible. Can we offer a blended option?
billing-bot: blended option computed: reserved 6 GPUs = $18,000/month (example), burst usage billed at $120/hr per GPU above baseline; blended estimate (assuming 20 burst hours/month) ~ $19,920/month. Final pricing to be confirmed by Finance.
Noor (Solutions Eng): I will produce a 1-pager (pool counts, perf bullets, autoscale yaml, preheat schedule, failover notes) and drop it here by Tue AM. Javier will attach AZ diagram. Sam will confirm discount tier with buyer.
Sam (Acct Exec): Thanks team. Let's meet Tue 11am for final review. :thumbsup:
